title: 第九章 七个工具人第十章 赶来的仇家
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了

我有这么说过吗？
那是我的真心话，还是给剑横秋下的一个饵？
赢商这个老狐狸，目光迷茫起来。
他这前半生里，耍心机的事情，做的太多了，连自己都忘了哪一句话是真，哪一句是假，但毫无疑问，剑横秋把这一句，听进了心里！
……
目光再次看向剑横秋，剑横秋也看向他，师徒二人，再次对视。
这对师徒二人，显然有着深重无比的羁绊！
“是你先蛊惑了我，你给了我希望，却不给我机会，宗门危在旦夕，既然你要死了，那就我来扛！”
剑横秋怒喝。
眉宇之间，既有冷酷霸道，还有豪情担当，这个小子，显然是个已经找到了自我之道的天骄豪雄。
赢商听的心头，一阵复杂。
琢磨了片刻，到底还是没有接话，再次转头看向其他六人。
“他留下的原因，我知道了，你们呢，不会就因为他这句话，就要继续留在这个破落宗门里吧？”
六人闻言，瞬间一抖，个个垂下头去，不敢看他，一个也不敢开口。
赢商马上明白，多半是剑横秋许给了他们重利，比如自己的身家，说不定还准许他们，瓜分了自己的身家之后，可以离宗而去。
老家伙眼中看着，沉吟了片刻，心中开口。
“宝灵，告诉我这些家伙，和我们的天道羁绊度是多少。”
“是，主人。”
声音响起脑海中。

“剑横秋，主人的大弟子，与你的羁绊度五星，已觉醒独属天赋——人心冷冰锋更冷！不过他和你的天道羁绊，已经变成负向，除非再转为正向，否则只能强行掠夺。”
“段立，二弟子，羁绊度三星。”
“陈飞渡，三弟子，羁绊度三星。”
“黄仙儿，四弟子，羁绊度三星。”
“陶大海，五弟子，羁绊度二星。”
“卓雨，六弟子，羁绊度二星。”
“于秋染，七弟子，羁绊度二星。”
赢商听过，面无表情。
七个弟子中，到底还是剑横秋这个大弟子的天道羁绊度最高，此子本来，是凡人中的武人，二人相遇时，剑横秋正遭受仇家追杀，赢商将他救了下来，收为徒弟，又带着他去报了家仇。当时还面临着另外一个剑修的竞争，赢商花了一点小手段，才收徒成功的。
而回归山门之中，除了悉心教导了极长一段时间，赢商甚至带着他去修真界历练，指点道法人心，师徒二人，也算感情深厚。
其他六人，有的是赢商亲自找来的弟子，有的是门中的其他人介绍来的，七人和他一样，全是冰修，得到他的指点，继承着他的衣钵。
赢商已经是冰修，他们的道体已经不需要，但独属的天份，却仍旧有用，尤其是剑横秋这个天才横溢的大弟子的肉身天份和独属天赋。
当然，七人如今，和他的天道羁绊度太低，就算为了活命的情况下，愿意主动贡献出来，赢商融合的成功率也不高。
为今之计，要的是他们修炼壮大起来，帮助赢商提升修炼速度。
七人之中，剑横秋是相气初期的境界，段立和陈飞渡是磐气后期，黄仙儿四人，全是磐气中期，而其中的剑横秋，段立，黄仙儿，卓雨四人，全离下一个境界不远。
“老夫若是……耍些心机手段，让剑横秋说出主动分享给我的话来，算他主动献祭给我吗？”
赢商沟通宝灵。
这个老狐狸，最擅长的就是转心机。
“主人这是钻天道空子，天道不予承认，无法融合成功。”

Did I say that?
Are those my true words, or are they a bait for Jian Hengqiu?
Yingshang, the old fox, looked confused.
In the first half of his life, he had done so many scheming things that he even forgot which sentence was true and which was false. But there was no doubt that Jian Hengqiu took this sentence into his heart!
…
He looked at Jian Hengqiu again, and Jian Hengqiu also looked at him. The master and disciple looked at each other again.
The two masters and apprentices obviously have a very deep bond!
"You bewitched me first. You gave me hope, but you didn't give me a chance. The sect is in danger. Since you are going to die, then I will take care of it!"
Jian Hengqiu shouted angrily.
Between his eyebrows, there is both coldness and dominance, as well as pride and responsibility. This boy is obviously a proud hero who has found his own way.
Yingshang's heart felt complicated after hearing this.
After pondering for a moment, he still didn't answer and turned to look at the other six people again.
"I know the reason why he stayed. As for you, won't you continue to stay in this dilapidated sect just because of his words?"
When the six people heard this, they trembled for a moment, all of them lowered their heads, not daring to look at him, and none of them dared to speak.
Ying Shang immediately understood that it was probably Jian Hengqiu who had promised them huge profits, such as his own net worth, and maybe even allowed them to leave the clan after dividing their own net worth.
The old guy looked at it, pondered for a moment, and spoke in his heart.
"Baoling, tell me how much these guys are tied to us by the way of heaven."
"Yes, Master."
The voice rang in my mind.
"Jian Hengqiu, the master's eldest disciple, has a five-star bond with you, and has awakened his unique talent - the human heart is even colder! However, the bond between him and you has become negative. Unless it turns positive again, he can only plunder by force."
"Duan Li, second disciple, bound to three stars."
"Chen Feidu, third disciple, bound to three stars."
"Huang Xian'er, the fourth disciple, bound to three stars."
"Tao Dahai, fifth disciple, bound to two stars."
"Zhuo Yu, sixth disciple, bound to two stars."
"Yu Qiuran, the seventh disciple, bound two stars."
Ying Shang heard this, his face expressionless.
Among the seven disciples, Jian Hengqiu, the eldest disciple, had the highest degree of bond with heaven. This boy was originally a warrior among mortals. When the two met, Jian Hengqiu was being hunted by his enemies. Ying Shang rescued him, accepted him as his disciple, and took him to avenge his family. At that time, he was also facing competition from another sword cultivator. Ying Shang had to use some tricks to successfully recruit a disciple.
When he returned to the mountain gate, in addition to teaching him carefully for a long period of time, Ying Shang even took him to the world of cultivation to experience and teach him the Taoism. The two masters and apprentices also had a deep relationship.
Some of the other six people were disciples that Ying Shang personally found, and some were introduced by other people in the sect. The seven of them, like him, were all ice cultivators who received his guidance and inherited his mantle.
Yingshang is already an ice cultivator, and their Tao body is no longer needed, but their unique talents are still useful, especially the physical talents and unique talents of Jian Hengqiu, a talented disciple.
Of course, the seven people's bond with him is too low now. Even if they are willing to actively contribute in order to survive, the success rate of Yingshang Fusion is not high.
For the current plan, what is needed is for them to grow stronger in cultivation and help Yingshang increase his cultivation speed.
Among the seven, Jian Hengqiu is in the early stage of Xiangqi, Duan Li and Chen Feidu are in the late stage of Panqi, Huang Xianer is all in the middle stage of Panqi, and among them, Jian Hengqiu, Duan Li, Huang Xianer, and Zhuo Yu are not far from the next stage.
"If I... play some scheming tricks and get Jian Hengqiu to say something that he shares with me, does that count as his taking the initiative to sacrifice to me?"
Win Business Communication Baoling.
What this old fox is best at is changing his mind.
"Master, this is the sky.Son, the way of heaven does not recognize it and the fusion cannot be successful. "
